text:
Residents:
Felix (30s) and Aisha (40s) work in town offices. Weekdays: out ~8:00–17:30, home evenings. Weekends: sleep in, errands midday, home rest of day. Felix hobbies: family calls, knitting, movies. Aisha hobbies: family calls, movies, houseplants, running.

Object Locations (Wed 23:59):
Balcony: Floor has watering can. Table has spray bottle, gardening gloves.
Bathroom: Shelf has detergent, laundry basket, Aisha’s razor/skincare, Felix’s skincare/toiletry bag. Med cabinet has Aisha’s meds. Sink has soap, toothbrush holder, Felix’s razor. Rack has towels for both.
Bedroom 1: Floor has ironing board. Desk has Aisha’s laptop. Dresser has Felix’s hair dryer. Nightstand has books, Aisha’s glasses, tablets for both, Felix’s phone. Bed/Wardrobe empty.
Entry: Floor has toolbox, Felix’s umbrella, vacuum, Felix’s backpack, Felix’s charger, Felix’s headphones, Felix’s laptop, Felix’s water bottle. Hook has Aisha’s backpack, Aisha’s headphones, Aisha’s jacket, Aisha’s lunchbox, Aisha’s notebook, Aisha’s pen, Aisha’s scarf, Aisha’s water bottle, Felix’s jacket, Felix’s scarf. Table has Felix’s keys, Felix’s wallet, Aisha’s keys, Aisha’s wallet. Shoe rack has Aisha’s running shoes, Felix’s shoes.
Kitchen: Counter has cutting board, kettle, knives, toaster, Felix’s vitamins, clock, kitchen knife, pan. Cupboard has duster, Aisha’s glass, Aisha’s mug, Felix’s mug, Felix’s lunchbox, plates, serving dish, snack bowl. Drawer has spatula. Table has fruit bowl. Pantry has shopping bag. Sink has bowls, Felix’s glass. Dish rack has Aisha’s water bottle. Chair/Floor empty.
Living: Armchair has cushion 2. Bookshelf has board game, frame, speaker, vase. Coffee table has candle, coasters, tissues. Couch has blanket, cushion 1, Felix’s knitting bag. Side table has lamp. TV stand has remote. Floor empty.
Office: All spots empty.

Notes:
Both residents leave for work around 08:00, taking personal items (phones, keys, wallets, bags, laptops, water bottles, outerwear) with them. They return around 17:30–17:45, placing these items back in the entryway (hooks, table, floor) or kitchen (water bottles). Felix’s work items (laptop, charger, headphones, jacket, scarf, keys, wallet, water bottle) are consistently moved to the entry floor/hook/table in the evening. Aisha’s work items (backpack, headphones, jacket, lunchbox, notebook, pen, scarf, water bottle) are moved to the entry hook/table. Aisha’s keys and wallet remain on the entry table. Felix’s shoes stay on the shoe rack. Kitchen items (bowls, mugs, glasses) are moved from sink to cupboard/dish rack overnight. Shared kitchen tools (knife, pan, spatula) are moved to the counter in the evening, likely for cooking.
